definitions.explanation: An advance notification given privately before an official announcement is made. Most commonly refers to personnel transfer notices in Japanese companies, where employees are told of upcoming transfers or promotions before the formal announcement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内示|ないじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received unofficial notice of a transfer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人事異動|じんじいどう}→人事異動：18627_jinjiidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内示|ないじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The unofficial notice for next month's personnel changes came out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内示|ないじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧な⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧だ。
examples.english: I got unofficial word of a promotion from the department head, but the formal announcement hasn't been made yet.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in Japanese workplace culture, where {内示|ないじ} refers to advance notice of personnel transfers (⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧), reassignments (⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧), or promotions (⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧). The {内示|ないじ} typically comes a few weeks before the official announcement (⟦{辞令|じれい}→辞令：09021_jirei⟧).

FORMS:
⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (inside, private) + {示|じ} (show, indicate). Literally "showing privately."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内示|ないじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive unofficial notice
- {内示|ないじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: unofficial notice comes out
- {内示|ないじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧: there was an unofficial notice
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内示|ないじ}: unofficial transfer notice
- ⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧{内示|ないじ}: personnel change advance notice
